## Problem

What decision, workflow or technical problem does this change address?

## Approach

Describe the implementation and important tradeoffs.

## Verification

- [ ] Type checking passes.
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Relevant behavior was runtime-tested.
- [ ] Visual changes include screenshots.
- [ ] New evidence or model values include source, date/version and confidence metadata.
- [ ] No credentials or private project data are included.
